note: F05: brms cox() without censoring under brms's default priors (student_t(3, 0.8, 2.5) on the Intercept, flat b, student_t(3, 0, 2.5) on sd, dirichlet(1) on sbhaz); the AutoBayes model is built from ab.default_priors(): ypos2 ~ x + (1 | g). standata has no cens, and every row contributes log h0 + eta - H0 exp(eta) (cox_varint's note). brms's default Intercept location is its log-link rule, log(median(Y)) to one decimal (log 2.2557 = 0.81; cox_bhaz_knots's default table has 0.5, log 1.71425 = 0.54), which on the cox model moves with the unit of time (in days instead of these units it is 6.7) though the likelihood does not: the I-spline bases are unit-free and the M-spline bases scale by a constant. Knots: boundary 0.136392 and 10.989208 (Y in [0.3451, 10.7805], widened by 2%), the median 2.2557
